sam.unionPolicy: union every raw detection returned for one sealed system/view prompt

controlledConstants: SAM model, threshold, and union policy
claimCeiling: This pair may establish Gemma 3 4B proposal sensitivity and downstream SAM mask utility for a subtle versus constitutive ruff-length difference on one authored procedural cat fixture. It cannot establish that the technique fails when Gemma misses, nor general semantic correctness, production grooming, arbitrary-source reconstruction, or visual admission.
modelFailureInterpretation: A Gemma 3 4B failure is a model-specific cheap-arm result only. Do not narrow the campaign hypothesis space or change technique until several more capable models are tested.

subtle-density12x.controlledDifference: Ruff baseline length 0.34 versus puffy length 0.19; region difference is visible but not constitutive at first glance.

constitutive-ruff2p5x.controlledDifference: Ruff length alone is multiplied by 2.5 from 0.34 to 0.85; puffy remains 0.19 and every estimator input and scoring rule is fixed.
